object_description: slender high-rise paired with an open-plan horizontal station volume
design_condition: The narrow tall volume is placed at the northeastern perimeter to define a new station square with the surrounding city fabric, while the lower station volume organizes transport access and platform connections.

positive.statement: The project creates a formative and attractive urban space with a clear address.
The skeletal structure is an easy-to-read node of public transport, with clearly visible stops, sales points, exits and vertical connections.
The commercial floor can be subdivided very flexibly, promising varied tenants and a high level of sustainability.
The apartments are well sized, well zoned and easy to furnish, with large outdoor spaces.

negative.statement: The implementation is very challenging, and a building technology concept is missing.
The technical rooms appear randomly sized and positioned.
The organization and structure of the underground car park are not entirely convincing.
Access to the long-term bicycle parking spaces via the underground parking ramp is not optimal.
